translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Guyau la biga katotila baisa la tomota
E Guyau matauna Isireli la Yaubada
ilukwaigu kawala, “Ka, kugini vavagi komwaidona avaka bogwa lalukwaim, bila olumoulela pilatala buki,

paila tuta bogwa eimamalu paila yeigu bakommolivau ulo tomota mina Isireli deli mina Yuda. E yeigu bakaimilivau matausina balau ovalu mapilana tubusia bogwa lasaiki omitibogwa e matausina biyosivauwaisi tuvaila valu mapilana bivigakaisi si vavagi tatousi. Yeigu Guyau bogwa lalivala.”
E Guyau ilivala baisa tomotela Isireli deli Yuda, kawala,

content.text: gala kaigalela vakota mitaga kokola wala.
Ki ibodi taitala tau biuni guditala gwadi?
makawala natala vivila eigigadi paila bitapoi yamala?
Avaka paila komwaidona tomota eigibugibu migisi?
Ka yam gaga makwaina bogwa leimaima;
tuta matutona kabommayuyu sainela bikaloubusi baisa ulo tomota,

content: E Guyau Topeuligaga eilivala kawala, “Avai tuta yam makwaina bima yeigu bakouwoli kaitakewa makaina okaiyasi deli bataneku kasi katupipi miyasina yuwoyoula tanamnumta, e togilagala gala tuvaila bivigakaisi matausina si ula.
Kaimapula matausina biwotitalaigusi yeigu Guyau si Yaubada, e yeigu bavasani taitala metoya Debida odalela biguyau.

content.text: “Mina Isireli gala wala availa ibodi bivitukukolaimi.
Yokomi ulo tomota, gala wala bukukokolasi.
Yeigu bakolaimi, e gala wala availa biyokukolaimi.

content: E Guyau iluki la tomota kawala,

content.text: e kami lewa gala wala availa bimweli.
deli kami pwasa gala wala kaituvala,
e matausina gala wala sitana ikaiki uwosi paila yokomi.
paila uula mi mitugaga saina bidubadu
Gala tuvaila bibodi bukutakulukulusi paila kami lewa;
paila gala wala avai vavagi bipilasaimi.
paila uula mi mitugaga saina bidubadu
Mitaga baisa tuta, availa availa matausina leivayoulimi
Availa availa matausina leilamidadaimi komwaidona bogwa bilamidadaisi,
e availa availa matausina eikwaiyaisi mi valu, komwaidona si valu bikwayaisi wala.
kaina goli kami tilaula bilivalasi kawasi,
“Yeigu igau bakaimilivau ulo tomota bamai osi valu
E tomotela biusiwosisi deli si yakaula;
E yeigu bamitukwaii matausina e bidalasi tuvaila;
Yeigu bavigivau boda makwaina si kaisisu kala peula makawala omitibogwa;
e yeigu bavitau otumalela e bakatukikiti tuvaila
Kasi tokaraiwaga bikaloubusi metoya osi boda titoulesi,
Matauna bimakaiagu avai tuta badou matauna.
Gala availa bimakaiagu kidamwa gala isim kala dou.

content: Guyau la gibuluwa makawala utuyagila, makwaina saina kweminimani gagabila bikatukwaisisuva odubasi matausina mina dubakasala. Makwaina gala biwokuva tatoula wala matauna bivigimkuloi komwaidona avaka leininamsi bivagi. E yam makwaisina omitasi bimaima la tomota bikatetasi vavagi makwaina kala mimilakatila.
